clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter's move across the country in March 1952, within the year: June's homesickness and daily letters to her sister, Walter out in the trees from dark to dark and distant from June, Glen's fights at school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan over land money, June kept to her bed for weeks that first winter, rows between Walter and June over money for new trees, and June joining the church choir and writing less to Edna by September 1953, where her anxiety eased and functioning rose.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failing, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the orchard's failure in May 1968, within the year: Walter drinking heavily most nights, Walter and Glen blaming each other over the loan, Glen taking over the family's money and talks with the bank, Carl's asthma attacks worse that winter, you wetting the bed again in April 1969, Ida's heart trouble found in May, and Walter stopping drinking and taking work pruning other men's trees by October 1969, where his functioning rose.

clusters.name: Glen's job lost at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within the year: Glen out of work most of that year and sitting in the truck for hours, loud fights between Glen and Marian at night over money, Marian taking a second job cleaning offices at night, you stopping eating properly and losing weight that summer, you keeping to your room and distancing from Marian, Walter drinking again after six years off it, and you eating again and making the track team by June 1976, where your functioning rose.

clusters.name: Wilma moving into Nora and Sam's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma moving into your house in January 1990, within the year and into 1991: you and Wilma clashing over the children's bedtimes and meals, Sam working late and keeping out of the rows, Sam taking his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, your eczema flaring on both hands, rows between you and Sam most nights, Wilma taking a flat in town by June 1991, and your eczema clearing over the summer, where your symptom eased.
